run_validate: run the validation script to evaluate a pretrained Listen to Look model on the validation dataset
run_validate_function: run the validate function to compute accuracy and mAP metrics on a validation data loader
run_main: run the main function to build the model, load a checkpoint, and validate against test data
review_validate_function: review the validate function that computes avgpool, LSTM, and GT prediction accuracy and mAP metrics
review_main_function: review the main function that sets up the model, checkpointer, validation dataset, and runs validation
